warranty.title: Warranty, returns & delivery
paragraphs: Every engine is supplied with a 12-month warranty as standard, as stated on this listing.
If the vehicle turns out not to be compatible, return the engine uninstalled within 14 days for a full refund including original delivery cost.
UK mainland delivery only, typically 2–4 working days on a kerbside pallet, with tracking emailed on dispatch.

about.title: About this unit
about.intro: This is the {brand} {code} engine in its {vehicle} configuration, carrying part number {sku}. If your vehicle is a different model or year, the correct unit for it is on its own application page - see the other applications below.
about.used: This used unit is removed from a donor vehicle, tested, and supplied with recorded mileage; a fully reconditioned option with new wear parts is available where it is shown as a selectable tab above. Every unit we supply is inspected and checked as standard before dispatch.
about.recon: This reconditioned unit is rebuilt with new wear parts, compression and leak-down tested, and supplied with the warranty shown above. Every unit we supply is inspected and checked as standard before dispatch.

fit.q: Q: Will this {code} engine fit my {vehicle}?
fit.a: A: This unit is listed for: {fits}. Enter your registration in the checker on this page to confirm your exact specification before ordering.

refund.q: Q: What if the engine doesn't fit after all?
refund.a: A: If your vehicle turns out not to be compatible, return the engine uninstalled within 14 days of delivery for a full refund including original delivery cost. The registration checker exists to prevent this happening in the first place.

historyUsed.q: Q: What mileage and history does this used engine have?
historyUsed.a: A: Recorded mileage and donor-vehicle history are shown on this listing before you buy, and every used unit is compression and leak-down tested prior to dispatch. If you'd prefer a fully rebuilt unit with new wear parts instead, the reconditioned option is shown as a selectable tab above where available, at its own listed price.

historyRecon.q: Q: What does reconditioned mean on this engine?
historyRecon.a: A: A reconditioned unit is rebuilt with new wear parts, then compression and leak-down tested and supplied with the warranty shown on this listing. If you'd prefer a lower-cost used unit, it is shown as a selectable tab above where available, at its own listed price.
